capability_preflight.need: trunks — one declared shared bus that splits
capability_preflight.result: both placements refused: 'no obstacle-safe route for nic -> s2, nic -> spare; increase node/layer spacing'
capability_preflight.note: Not used for two independent reasons. (1) The renderer refused the only candidate bus in both placements tried. (2) The source has no genuine one-to-many shared bus on the observed path: the /29 is a routed prefix whose members hold independent links to the gateway, and two of them carry their own qualifier ('free?' unconfirmed for .60-.62, 'no link seen' for the dark ports) that a trunk spur cannot express, because SpecTrunk has no per-branch label or style. Drawing one corridor would have faked a shared physical bus and dropped per-member uncertainty. The segment is drawn as same-rank peers with per-member arrow direction and dash instead.

capability_preflight.result: ports, hosts, pool, fabric (v1); ports, fabric, transit, internet (v2)

capability_preflight.need: dots: 1 — exactly one live dot per route
capability_preflight.result: dots: 1 on the active routes (s1->nic, nic->gw, gw->airtel, airtel->airtelbb, airtelbb->cf) and dots: 0 on the inactive or unused ones (dark ports, server2, free pool), so 'one active uplink, seven dark' and 'no traffic to the neighbour or the pool' are visible as motion and not only as text
dark->s1 'no link seen' (inactive interfaces do not prove no cable) and spare->gw 'free?' (unresponsive addresses do not prove free)
